sections.Physical Dimensions: Per cutter.com.au MCPCB-XP20Star: 20 x 20 x 1.7 mm, board thickness 1.65 mm, copper base, ENIG; emitter footprint 3.45 x 3.45. Second pass: LEDSupply INDUS 1-Up Cree XP-E2 20 mm star is described as a 20 mm HEXAGONAL star MCPCB with four large solder pads (https://www.ledsupply.com/leds/1-up-cree-xlamp-xpe2-white-high-power-led, S4), and an RS-hosted 20 mm star datasheet (https://nonprod.docs.rs-online.com/8a51/0900766b810b03f6.pdf, S4) states 'star is nominal 20 mm A/F' (across flats), MCPCB thickness 2 mm, and M3 mounting-hole centres 17.5 mm. So the OHMNI outline is a hexagon 20.0 across flats (outline parameter hex|round, default hex), thickness 1.65-2.0 (default 1.65, vendor range), mounting holes M3 (3.2 drill assumed UNCERTAIN) at 17.5 centre spacing. Overall height DERIVED = 1.65 + emitter H 2.0 = 3.65 (UNCERTAIN L). Pad rectangles and optic holes: still RESEARCH_REQUIRED.
sections.Geometry: Hexagonal disc (20 mm across flats, default; round selectable) 1.65 thick with solder-mask top, central emitter (OHM-085 instance), 4 small wire pads (2 anode, 2 cathode) near the rim; vendor-dependent star lobes and optic pin holes.
sections.Leads / Pins / Terminals: Wire pads rectangular, size RESEARCH_REQUIRED (default 3.0 x 2.0 UNCERTAIN L), placed on +/-X axis; plus the emitter's own pads (child OHM-085). Not modeled: wires.
sections.PCB Interface: Assembly: board is mounted by thermal adhesive, so its standoff is 0 and its footprint is a wire/pad pattern with emitter at origin. FCO origin = emitter center. Emitter must not be re-originated.
sections.Materials: Base MAT_COPPER (exposed edge), top solder mask via proposed token MAT_MCPCB_MASK_WHITE (#EDEDE8, 0.5); pads MAT_GOLD; emitter materials from OHM-085.
sections.Appearance: White solder-mask disc with silver copper edge, gold pads, + and - silk markings, a bright emitter in the center.
sections.Orientation Markings: + and - silkscreen near the wire pads. Emitter cathode marker as OHM-085.
sections.Recognition Features: 1) 20 mm across-flats hex disc (or round). 2) Emitter at center. 3) + / - wire pads. 4) Thickness 1.65.
sections.Parametric Variants: Parameters: diameter, thickness, emitter member, outline (hex default | round | lobed star). Coupled: emitter pad pattern.
sections.Recommended Base Geometry: Cylinder + OHM-085 child + 4 thin boxes (pads) + silk decals.
sections.Modeling Procedure: 1) Disc D x 1.65 with underside at Z=0. 2) Insert OHM-085 on top (Z=1.65). 3) Add pads. 4) Add silk decals.
sections.LOD Strategy: LOD0 disc + emitter box; LOD1 + pads + dome; LOD2 optic holes, lobes.
